definition: The four-domain learning profile produced by the psychometric assessment: preferred ways of learning, dominant intelligences, areas needing support, and the tone that works best.
The level or risk category of a trait result: low, medium or high. In three trait groups it means risk; everywhere else it means level.
The plan tier without genetic features.
A screen that shows how a plan's targets were calculated, including the genetic adjustments. There is a nutrition blueprint and an athletic blueprint.
The reward currency in the cognitive games.
The platform's term for the subject of the data: a student, or an adult wellness user.
The defined set of users a genetic counsellor is responsible for. Everything a counsellor can see or do derives from it.
The authoritative daily nutrition total, combining planned meals, completions, scans and quick logs.
India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act of 2023, the governing privacy law.
A physical kiosk that takes basic health measurements.
A sample-collection event held at a school.
Android's platform-level health data hub, which Samsung Health and other apps write into.
The platform's AI companion: a tutor for students, a professional assistant for parents.
A parent account plus the child accounts under it.
See AURE profile. Also used for the curated nine-indicator view a teacher sees.
The per-chapter study surface with summary, ask, flashcards, quiz, book and videos.
Where a trait result sits on a visual scale in the laboratory report.
An estimate of how well a student knows a particular chapter, derived from quizzes, teach-backs, study sessions and exam results.
The child's or adult's own genetic report section in the app.
The platform's framing for comparing inherited disposition against measured environment and lifestyle.
Food photograph analysis.
One of approximately 416 defined environmental or lifestyle measurements.
A syllabus-level plan covering every chapter of every subject across an academic year.
A family health chart collected from the parent.
The plan tier that includes genetic features.
A group of related genetic traits, such as the vitamins profile. Twenty-six exist.
The feature where the tutor starts the conversation, at most once a day.
The learning-style questionnaire.
A goal-driven multi-week learning path.
The anonymous identifier, such as CA101, under which all genetic data is stored.
The student-focused product mode.
A weekly plan across the student's weak and focus chapters.
A session where a child explains a concept in their own words and the tutor assesses understanding.
Answering from the child's actual prescribed textbook rather than from general knowledge.
A single genetic characteristic with a result, the genes behind it and advice. Approximately 113 to 117 per report.
The adult-focused product mode.
